Hi Alex / Sanjay —

Great to meet you both on the call earlier. This thread is a quick post-call recap and the intake we need to move the POC trial into planning. High-level items below; please confirm or correct anything I missed.

1) Success criteria (draft)
- End-to-end latency (median) for “primary flow” under expected load <= 250ms
- Token-cost per 1k responses within +/- 20% of Redwood estimate once we have real traffic
- No functional regressions vs baseline prompts in our eval suite
- Integration-ready SDK call pattern and monitoring hooks present

2) Evaluation plan
- 2-week trial with synthetic + sampled production traffic (you to provide sample)
- We run daily perf & quality runs tied to the same prompt set you use in prod
- Weekly syncs (Mon mornings) for results and next-step decision

3) Timeline (proposed)
- May 25: intake + sample traffic
- May 28: confirm final success criteria & SOW sign-off
- Jun 2: trial kickoff (provisioned endpoints + shared test keys)
- Jun 16: trial end + readout

4) Ownership
- Redwood: trial provisioning, perf monitoring, baseline evals — Ben / Dylan
- AcmeHealth: sample traffic, target success metrics, procurement/SOW — Alex / Sanjay

5) Workload & traffic intake (please provide answers to the questions below; sample CSV helpful)
- Typical RPS for primary flow (avg / peak)?
- Typical prompt token length distribution (median, 90th percentile) and response token length distribution
- Concurrent requests typical and max (P95 / P99 concurrency)
- Burst pattern examples (e.g., daily funnel, batch spikes, marketing-driven blasts)

Attachments: workload_profile_template.xlsx (template to fill), trial_scope_v1.pdf (proposed scope)

Action: Please reply with the filled workload template or a short note with the numbers above by EOD May 27 so we can start provisioning. Happy to jump on a quick sync if helpful.

Thanks,

Thanks — got the sample. Quick sizing notes and proposed config for the Jun 2 trial kickoff:

Technical assumptions based on Alex's sample:
- Median prompt 48 tokens; p90 prompt 210 tokens. Median response 32 tokens; p90 response 280 tokens.
- Steady-state avg 8 RPS, p95 concurrency ~60, p99 concurrency ~140, rare bursts to ~200 RPS for ~2–3 minutes.

Proposed trial cluster (short-lived dedicated pool):
- 4 x A40-equivalent GPUs (quantized runtime) with continuous batching enabled
- Autoscaler policy: target RPS headroom 2.5x for p95; burst mode enabled to add 2 GPUs for short bursts
- Max concurrent connections per node tuned to keep median latency <250ms under steady-state
- KV/prefix caching enabled for repeated prompts (we'll request your common prefixes when we set up)

Evaluation metrics we'll collect daily:
- Median, p90, p99 latency for primary flow
- Cost per 1k responses (token-based) and delta vs Redwood estimate
- Quality regression vs baseline prompt set (we'll run your sample eval prompts each night)

Action items:
- Redwood (Ben): provision cluster Jun 1 (warm), endpoints + test keys Jun 2 AM, load test plan by Jun 1 EOD
- Redwood (Dylan): eval harness + baseline prompts ready Jun 1 EOD
- Acme (Alex): confirm prefixes for cache and share any additional large-batch windows (marketing cadence)

I'll draft the infra sizing doc and share in the Drive link Marissa posted. Thoughts?
